name: Andou Dai
source:
Another mechanic friend of Pollon’s; 16 years old.

Ando, as everyone calls him, is another gravbike street racer, but he prefers tinkering with the machinery over operating it. He’s also an employee at the Tabuchi Motors auto repair shop.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
